correctness.rationale: Exact inverse-edge construction and BFS shortest-path proof cover every off-diagonal unordered pair. The C++17 code recomputes all transitions and tests 1,510,524,000 unordered pairs over 1000 fully specified instances, rejecting missing distances or discrepant maxima/multiplicities. The independently implemented explicit pair graph oracle agrees for k≤40 and forward BFS from farthest pairs for k in {1,16,17,40,101,499,500,501,999,1000}. Result is strictly finite k≤1000.

value.rationale: This is an exact and independently reproducible finite cutoff for a stated open synchronization invariant, proving 984 additional consecutive parameter values beyond the published theorem and locating one unique extremal unordered pair for all 1000 instances. The 3006-state largest example and 1.51 billion pair-distance evaluations provide substantive resolution of the natural finite domain, not an arbitrary small slice or a proof of the all-k conjecture.
